title: Ravin the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He was Rav Papa’s student, as in Bava Batra 146b, where he sat before him. In Kiddushin 53b: “Ravin the Elder interpreted before Rav”; Hyman proposes the reading “before Rav Papa,” as cited in Dikdukei Soferim on Pesachim 74b, note פ. And where we find in Pesachim 74b, “Ravin the Elder coated a young pigeon for Rav,” he proposes the reading there as Rav Yeiva the Elder, whom he identifies as Rav’s student, as explained in his entry.

notes.text: The Dikdukei Soferim reference is letter פ, retained literally rather than presented as an independently established numbered note 80. Hyman’s proposed Papa/Yeiva readings and historical identification remain attributed. Saved Davidson Pesachim 74b retains Ravin the Elder in the coating episode.
